pick.name: Weekly radar: reader-first, 45 minutes, Friday
pick.what: 1) 10 min: Inoreader 'AI' folder (AINews week, Simon Willison, Import AI, releases.atom). 2) 10 min: HF Daily Papers weekly view, star max 3. 3) 5 min: OpenRouter Rankings + Arena changes. 4) 10 min: one talk/podcast segment. 5) 10 min: write 3 bullets in Obsidian 'radar/YYYY-WW.md' and turn one into a LinkedIn/X post via Buffer
pick.why: Uses only tools already picked, ends with a written note and one public post, so learning also feeds the personal brand

alts.name: Claude Code scheduled digest
alts.what: A scheduled Claude Code run that reads starred items (Miniflux API or exported feeds) and drafts radar/YYYY-WW.md
alts.why: Cuts the routine to ~20 min once Miniflux is in place

alts.name: Folo AI timeline summaries
alts.what: Open-source AI RSS reader with scheduled daily/weekly briefings
alts.why: All-in-one AI digest without building anything; young project, AGPL, freemium
alts.free_limits: Free app; paid tiers for AI quota (reported)

decision: Run the 45-minute Friday routine manually for a month, then automate step 1-2 with a Claude Code scheduled digest over Miniflux if it sticks. Daily: only the AINews email subject lines (2 min).

verify.note: Not independently re-opened (search budget exhausted); free curated content, low risk, no numeric/legal claims.
